text_block_list.name: Tran's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haaah. You were taking such wobbly toddler 
steps back then, too~. And now, you're 
already running in races...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...You said that last time too. Can we 
stop doing this? Watching 'home videos' 
every single time we get together?"

text_block_list.name: Tran's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Nope~. This is Mom and Dad's favorite 
documentary footage, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...It's all well and good that you love 
him so much, but the boy's going through 
puberty right now! Show some tact, damn 
it~!

Spending family time with her busy parents 
brought rest and comfort to Transcend, 
body and soul.
